entries.claim: FORMAT.md still says the text before the first spine decision (line 240) and before the first epic (line 251) is text 'which no rule reads'. The new stamp rule contradicts this: checkStamp/stampLines (lib/check.mjs:70-91) now scan exactly that zone and fail lines in it. The diff edited the sentences directly above (232, 242) to mention the stamp line but left these two unchanged.
entries.failure_scenario: A spine.md has a prose line under its title that begins 'Built from:', for example 'Built from: the treasurer interviews'. FORMAT.md line 240 tells a reader no rule reads text before the first decision, so the line looks safe. Yet `node lib/check.mjs --spine <dir>` and the full check both exit 1 with `spine.md: Built from: "Built from: the treasurer interviews" is not a "Built from: prd.md sha256:<16 lowercase hex digits>" stamp`. The format text and the check now disagree about that zone, and the same goes for epics.md at line 251.
